title: 第三十七章 当面锣鼓第三十六章 请君入瓮
content_zh:
卫府的门槛，比江砚一个人还高。
他跨进去的时候，门口两个青衣家丁上下打量他，那眼神，像在看一件不知怎么混进来的破物件。江砚没理会，只把脊背挺直了往里走。这半年坊市里熬出来的本事，头一桩就是——越是被人看轻的时候，腰越不能弯。
宴设在花厅。说是“招贤”，厅里坐的却没几个像“贤”的。一水儿的锦衣华服，三三两两地说笑，江砚一进去，那些目光便“唰”地齐齐落到他身上，话音也低了下去。
“这就是城西那个会写会算的少年先生？”
“瞧着也不过是个穷小子。”
“嘘——听说邪门得很……”
窃窃私语像针，密密麻麻地扎过来。江砚面上不动声色，心里却把这满厅的人都过了一遍。他来之前就盘算清楚了：今日这场，斗的不是笔，是人心，是气势。他一个穷小子，越是露怯，便越是死路。
主位上坐着的，是个四十上下的中年人。锦袍玉带，面皮白净，一双眼睛却生得有些细长，笑起来的时候，眼角是往下耷的，透着股说不出的阴鸷。
这便是下帖子的卫家旁支当家，卫琰。
“江先生来了。”卫琰慢悠悠开口，抬手虚引，“坐。”
下人搬来个矮凳，搁在末席最角落的地方。这是明摆着的羞辱——满厅都是椅，独他一个矮凳。
江砚也不恼，撩袍坐了。
“久闻先生大名。”卫琰端起酒盏，呷了一口，“都说城西出了个能写会算、还‘邪门’的少年。本公子今日设这场宴，就是想见识见识，先生这‘邪门’，究竟邪在何处。”
满厅的人都笑了起来。
江砚拱了拱手：“坊市里以讹传讹，当不得真。小人不过识几个字，替人写写文书，混口饭吃。哪有什么邪门。”
“是么。”卫琰放下酒盏，眼角那点笑意更深了，“可本公子听说，先生写的东西，有时候……能从纸上‘走’下来。”
厅里一静。
江砚的瞳孔几不可察地缩了一下。
果然。他们盯上的，从来不是他写文书的本事，是那支笔。卫家费这么大周章设宴拿秦伯做筏子，要的就是把他这“造物”的能耐，亲眼验明，再——摹了去。
“公子说笑了。”江砚面色不变，“字写在纸上，能‘走’下来，那不成神仙了。”

“神仙不神仙的，”卫琰淡淡道，“试试便知。”
他抬了抬手。
两个家丁抬上来一张乌木大案，案上摆着文房四宝，墨已研好。卫琰从袖中取出一方巴掌大的、灰扑扑的石板，搁在案上。
那石板看着寻常，江砚却莫名觉得后颈一凉。
“这是我卫氏的传家本事，唤作‘摹刻’。”卫琰的声音里透出一股矜傲，“先生且看好了。”
他起身，走到案前，伸出食指，在唇边一咬。
一滴血珠渗出来。
卫琰将那滴血，缓缓抹在灰石板上。血珠渗进石纹，那石板竟“嗡”地一声，泛起一层幽幽的暗红。他口中念念有词，指尖在石上一拓——
案上凭空多出一柄短刀。
满厅响起一片抽气与喝彩声。那刀通体青黑，刀身上还流转着一缕未散的红光，乍一看，竟与真刀无异。
“如何？”卫琰转过头，居高临下地看着江砚，眼里写满了得意，“这便是我卫氏‘凭空造物’的本事。先生那点‘邪门’，可比得过？”
厅里的目光又齐刷刷地压到江砚身上，幸灾乐祸的，看好戏的，等着看这穷小子如何下不来台的。
江砚却没看那些人。
他的目光，落在案上那柄“刀”上。
他这半年练笔，最先悟透的就一桩——他造的东西，是从“懂”里生出来的，是活的；而眼前这柄刀……
content_en:
The threshold of the Wei Mansion is higher than Jiang Yan alone.
When he stepped in, two servants in Tsing Yi at the door looked at him up and down, as if they were looking at a broken object that had somehow slipped in. Jiang Yan ignored it, straightened his back and walked inside. The first thing I have learned in the past six months is that the more I am looked down upon, the less I can bend my waist.
The banquet was held in the flower hall. It was said to be "recruiting talents", but there were not many "virtuous" people sitting in the hall. Yi Shui'er was dressed in rich clothes, chatting and laughing in twos and threes. As soon as Jiang Yan entered, all those eyes fell on him with a "swish", and his voice dropped.
"Is this the young gentleman in the west of the city who can write and do math?"
"Looks like he's just a poor boy."
"Hush - I heard that the evil sect is very evil..."
Whispers are like needles, piercing through densely. Jiang Yan remained calm on his face, but in his heart he went through all the people in the hall. He had calculated it clearly before he came: today's battle is not about pens, but about people's hearts and momentum. He is a poor boy, and the more timid he shows, the more likely he is to die.
Sitting on the main seat was a middle-aged man in his forties. She has a brocade robe and a jade belt, a fair complexion, but a pair of eyes that are a bit slender. When she smiles, the corners of her eyes droop downward, revealing an indescribable sinister look.
This is the head of the Wei family branch in the next post, Wei Yan.
"Mr. Jiang is here." Wei Yan said slowly, raising his hand to beckon, "Sit down."
The servants brought a low stool and placed it in the corner of the last table. This was an obvious humiliation - there were only chairs in the hall, and he was the only one with a low stool.
Jiang Yan wasn't upset, so he lifted up his robe and sat down.
"I've heard about Sir's name for a long time." Wei Yan picked up the wine cup and took a sip, "It is said that there is a young man in the west of the city who is good at writing and arithmetic, and is also an 'evil' man. I am hosting this banquet today just to see where Sir's 'evil' is."
Everyone in the hall laughed.
Jiang Yan cupped his hands and said: "There are lies spread around the city, but they cannot be taken seriously. The villain only knows a few words, writes documents for others, and earns a living. How can there be any evil sect."
"Really." Wei Yan put down the wine cup, and the smile in the corner of his eyes deepened, "But I heard that the things you write can sometimes... come off the paper."
The hall fell silent.
Jiang Yan's pupils shrank almost imperceptibly.
really. What they focused on was never his ability to write documents, but the pen. The reason why the Wei family spent so much money to hold a banquet and use Uncle Qin as a raft was to test the capabilities of his "creation" with their own eyes and then - imitate it.
"Young Master is joking." Jiang Yan's expression remained unchanged, "If the words can be written on paper and they can 'walk' down, then you won't be a god."
"Whether it's a fairy or not," Wei Yan said lightly, "you'll know after you try it."
He raised his hand.
Two servants brought up a large ebony case with the four treasures of the study on it, and the ink had been polished. Wei Yan took out a palm-sized, dusty stone slab from his sleeve and placed it on the case.
The stone slab looked ordinary, but Jiang Yan felt an inexplicable chill on the back of his neck.
"This is the heirloom skill of my Wei clan, which is called 'copying'." There was a hint of pride in Wei Yan's voice, "Sir, please keep an eye on it."
He stood up, walked to the case, stretched out his index finger, and bit his lips.
A drop of blood seeped out.
Wei Yan slowly wiped the drop of blood on the gray stone. Blood beads seeped into the stone patterns, and the stone slab buzzed with a faint dark red color. He muttered words and touched the stone with his fingertips——
A short knife appeared out of thin air on the case.
The hall filled with gasps and cheers. The sword was completely green and black, and there was still a ray of red light flowing on the blade. At first glance, it looked like a real sword.
"How?" Wei Yan turned his head and looked at Jiang Yan condescendingly, his eyes full of pride, "This is my Wei family's ability to 'create things out of thin air'. How can it be compared to Sir's 'evil ways'?"
All the eyes in the hall turned to Jiang Yan again, gloating about his misfortune., Those who watch the show are waiting to see how this poor boy can't get off the stage.
Jiang Yan didn't look at those people.
His eyes fell on the "knife" on the case.
In the past six months of practicing writing, he has realized one thing first - the things he creates are born from "understanding" and are alive; and the knife in front of him...
